lead: A nesting sweep is spelled `array<array<array<mixed>>>`, and `flatten` cannot be iterated to a fixed point.
body: `Core\Arr::flatten`'s parameter is `array<array<T>>`, so `Core\Arr::flatten($x)` over its own `array<mixed>` answer is `E0401`. Write one step over many shapes: `array<array<array<mixed>>> $rows` with `foreach ($rows as array<array<mixed>> $row)` makes nestings data, and `Core\Str::countOf($json, "[") == 1` asserts an answer holds no nested array.
